nodes.description: Private address state variable holding the Uniswap V2 router address used to perform swaps.
Private address state variable holding the Uniswap V2 factory address.
Public override function that pulls tokens from spender and swaps them via the configured Uniswap V2 router, returning the received output amount.
Constructor setting the router and factory addresses for the DEX adapter.
Receive fallback allowing the contract to accept native ETH.
Block timestamp used as the swap deadline argument, making execution time-dependent.
Amount of sell token to transfer in and swap.
Minimum acceptable amount of buy token out of the swap.
Address from which the sell tokens are pulled via transferFrom.
Recipient address that receives the swapped output tokens.
Array of token addresses describing the swap path.
Local variable derived from the last element of path, representing the bought token.
Local variable derived from the first element of path, representing the sold token.
Local array holding the amounts returned by the router swap call.
External call to IUniswapV2Router02.swapExactTokensForTokens with user-controlled path, target and timestamp deadline; can transfer control to arbitrary path tokens.
ERC20 safeTransferFrom pulling amountIn sell tokens from the spender into this contract before the swap.

edges.reason: amountIn parameter is passed as the value transferred from spender into the contract.
spender parameter is the source address of the safeTransferFrom call.
User-supplied path array is forwarded to the router swap call.
minAmountOut is passed as the swap slippage protection argument.
target address is passed as the swap output recipient.
block.timestamp is used as the swap deadline, making the swap outcome time-dependent and manipulable by miners.
uniswapRouter state variable is cast and used as the router for the external swap call.
returned local array is assigned the result of the router swap call.
doSwap executes the safeTransferFrom token pull.
doSwap executes the external router swap call.
External call to the router (and via path tokens) transfers control externally and can re-enter doSwap before state settles, since no reentrancy guard is present.
Constructor writes the uniswapRouter state variable.
Constructor writes the uniswapFactory state variable.

normalization_plan.reason: amountIn is a function-scoped parameter consumed only by doSwap and its token pull; it carries no independent on-chain semantics.
minAmountOut is a function-scoped parameter used only to bound the swap output inside doSwap.
spender is a function-scoped parameter controlling the transferFrom source within doSwap.
target is a function-scoped parameter forwarded directly as the recipient of the external swap call.
path is a function-scoped array parameter that directly determines the token route of the unsafe external swap call.
buyToken is a local derived value used only for the swap path handling.
sellToken is a local derived value used only as the source token of the transferFrom operation.
returned is a local array holding the output amounts of the external swap call and has no standalone purpose.
